Calgary Police Release Suspect Images in Extortion Probe

Calgary police have released pictures of 15 suspects in connection with an ongoing extortion scheme. The investigation has led to charges against 16 men, primarily of Indian descent and on visas, who are alleged to have targeted the South Asian community. While mugshots of 15 suspects were made public, only one individual remains in detention, with the others having been granted bail.
